subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB1106
title: Requires the court in a parenting time proceeding to order that the child who is the subject of the proceeding receive mental health therapy if the child is at least 5 years old but less than 18 years old.
headline: SB 1106 did not pass

claims.text: SB 1106 was introduced in the Senate on February 27, 2025.
SB 1106 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 3 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
